reviews.review:
Does this game have a Mass Effect feel? Yes
Is this the best Mass Effect game? No
Was this game playable on release? No
Is it better now? Yes
Can I play it even if I haven't played the other Mass Effect games? Absolutely

The engine is not known for it's stability, so technical issues were to be expected(game freezing, dropping to windowed mode, audio issues, etc.).
Default appearance for main characters is quite frankly horrible, luckily it's easily fixed with choosing another preset. The voice acting is very good. The graphics are solid, gorgeous in some places, unbelievable in others(but you can't quite put a finger on it unless inspected closely). 
The game starts out great, but feels repetitive and long in the middle of the game(pacing problem), then picks up by the end.
It had some cringy story/conversational moments(in all bearable) and big revelations were expected due to heavy breadcrumbs.

All in all, I did enjoy playing this game and would play the sequels...

This game is obviously not without controversy, given the expectations of the series and the tortured dev process.

It's not a bad game, however. it's worse failing is the feeling throughout of what _could have been and almost was_.

Whilst a lot of fuss was made over some of the poor character animation, I felt there were many great graphical moments in this game - some the planets, the second desert world in particular, were quite stunning.  
  The play areas were large but reminded you of the previous promise of totally open worlds with their arbitrary boundaries.  The vehicle physics was a great improvement over previous games: it was a little outlandish but certainly fun. 
  You can feel in the game a definite tension between what mass effect games were and what they could be. There's hints of a more strategic game in there, with the potential for real inter-group conflicts raging over planets and between them, something dynamic, emergent and unexpected. 
  However, Mass effect was always an on-rails game despite its galactic scope and it's seems that these hints of something greater were whittled away till the game resembled mass effect, only with some of its best features (story, dialog, sound design, character modelling) a little rough around the edges at times and with a number of half formed improvements to the original formula bolted on. 
  Perhaps without the baggage of the previous games, this could have been something more exciting. It almost was.

Despite all this, I enjoyed my time in the game. There's a lot to see, some truly spectacular galactic vistas to enjoy and whilst parts of the experience could have used extra polish, this is still an AAA game.
The graphics, the game play, are all awesome

i guess that my 186.6 hours playing this speaks for itself - but just in case: bloody brilliant!!!!! perfect blend of gameplay (ie. story/relationships/chatting & romance!!!), battles, cruising the universe and scanning planets for minerals etc, excellent and fun skill building of various types ... sad it's over actually (always the mark of a great game) ... my PC froze up once or twice in my entire playtime so no complaints with regard to bugs. i've played all of the mass effect games and loved each one of them. this one is no different. more like this please?? i'm going through a heavy personal time at the moment (partner sick and other stuff) and this game has engaged me, delighted me, and stopped me from incessantly worrying, for which i also thank it!! :)

As someone who was burned by this game when it released in 2017, now, after many years, and time, I can say I had fun. Solid 7/10. Some of the graphics and animations are a little weird, but not the worst. Most of the characters are fun, some romances got more love than others, the story and BBEG are simple enough. The combat and plethora of powers are great, along with the variety of different weapons. So yes, I say pick this up on sale, enjoy being in the Mass Effect universe again. Stay Strong and Clear
